name: Torchlit Blocktale
oneLine: Block-character stories lit like a film set: ember interiors and moonlit nights, deep saturation over crushed blacks, a camera that pushes in on every shot, hard cuts on the word every 1.4 s, one white word on screen at a time.
bestFor: Long (2-3 min) eerie or wondrous 'In this town' rule stories at night or by lantern light, with a recurring lead, a creature or big reveal, and diegetic rule props (signs, clocks, marks).
brightness: Mean 82/255 (night 60-75, interior 75-90, day or golden hour 95-105); 30-45% of pixels below 40; highlights 1-3%; vignette edges 15-28% darker; calibrated on our scene: ember 77, moon 69, golden 94, day 95
saturation: Mean 0.64 (target 0.60-0.72); one dominant temperature per scene (ember orange or lilac moonlight) plus one opposite accent
avgShot: 1.54 s average, 1.30-1.40 s median over 594 shots (10th/90th percentile 0.6/2.6 s); about 38 cuts/min for the whole video; open at 1.0-1.3 s per shot (the newest upload: 0.94 s); 85%+ of cuts on a word onset; 4-6 words per shot
camera: Never locked off: 64-85% of shots push in (pooled about 71%) at +3 to +9%/s, default +6.5%/s (snap pushes +30-85%/s, 1-4/min), 1-3 px rms handheld wobble (6-14 px in action), roll drift 1.5-4 deg/s on about half the shots; framing 26% wide, 24% full, 26% medium, 13% close, 6% extreme close, 7% insert; 12% low angle, 6% top-down; 26 mm look (70 deg vertical FOV)
characters: Classic R6 block bodies with rounded classic heads and flat ink sticker faces (solid black oval eyes, thick brows, red open mouths, no nose); one expression per shot; the lead has one signature colour; see characters.json (Inkface Blockfolk)
textures: Smooth game plastic on skin and hair, real 3D game maps (wood grain, stone, grass), the richest texture on clothing (knit, denim, leather); emissive practicals and magic with bloom; no outlines, grain or haze
animation: The camera carries the motion; characters hold readable poses or simple game walks and tumbles; no lip sync or blinks; looping emissive VFX; 2D stickers stepped at 10 fps; prop time-skips (calendar flip, clock)
captions: One lowercase word at a time, white with a 4 px black outline and a 60% shadow, Poppins Bold 72 px, centred x 540, baseline y 1330, 2-frame 85->100% pop, shown from word onset to the next word (pack/captions_gneef.json); no title card, emoji or coloured keywords
sound: Narration 3.2-3.5 words/s from frame 0 to the last frame; continuous bed about 10 dB under the voice (never silent); 7-22 low hits and 15-35 high transients per minute placed on actions, not cuts
overrides: Camera 02: cuts for the whole video (about 39/min, about 60/min in the opening) instead of 20-25 s of cuts then one glide
Camera 02 / top rule 3: soft handheld wobble (1-3 px), roll drift and snap pushes (safe version: no whip re-frames)
Sound 03: continuous bed under the voice instead of effects only (fallback: ambience bed at -10 dB)
On screen: one white word at a time instead of the house font with coloured keywords
Look 01: frame 0 is a moving establishing shot with the first caption word, no title (title goes on the thumbnail and cover)
Brightness: target 70-100 instead of our usual 95-100 (nights darker)

techniques.name: Continuous slow push-in
techniques.timing: linear across the whole shot, continuing through the cut
techniques.blender: dolly along the view axis d(t)=d0*(1-0.065t), linear F-curve

techniques.name: Snap push
techniques.blender: dolly 25-45% in 18 frames, Bezier ease-out

techniques.name: Slow pull-out reveal
techniques.blender: reverse dolly

techniques.name: Handheld micro-wobble
techniques.size: 1-3 px rms calm, 6-14 px rms action/boat (at 1080 wide)
techniques.blender: Noise modifier on camera rot X/Z, Scale 9 frames, Strength 0.10 deg calm / 0.45 deg action

techniques.name: Roll drift (Dutch drift)
techniques.blender: keyframe camera roll 0 to +-2.5 deg

techniques.name: Boat rock
techniques.blender: roll driver 4*sin(frame/30*2.5)

techniques.name: Tilt-up reveal
techniques.trigger: introducing a character or the twist
techniques.blender: camera Z +1.5 units over 72 frames with a look-at on the face

techniques.name: Fast lateral truck
techniques.blender: camera X +3-4 units over 36 frames, linear

techniques.name: Whip re-frame
techniques.blender: 3-frame constant-interpolation jump

techniques.name: Plunge zoom top-down
techniques.trigger: falling into a portal or pit
techniques.blender: top-down camera dolly down 50% in 24 frames

techniques.name: Follow-tumble
techniques.size: tracks about 20 px/frame with a slight roll
techniques.blender: camera parented to an empty with Damped Track on the ragdoll

techniques.name: Low-angle hero/creature
techniques.size: camera at knee height, 20-35 deg up
techniques.blender: camera Z 0.4-0.8 m, pitch +25 deg

techniques.name: Top-down
techniques.blender: pitch -90 deg

techniques.name: Extreme close-up on a face sticker
techniques.size: eye or mouth fills about 60% of the frame
techniques.blender: 70-85 mm lens, 0.3 m from the head

techniques.name: Diegetic insert
techniques.trigger: stating a rule, time or number
techniques.blender: model the prop as its own shot

techniques.name: Calendar page-flip time skip
techniques.size: page rotates 90 deg on its left edge
techniques.blender: rotate the page Y 0 to -90 deg, ease-in

techniques.name: Hard cut on the word
techniques.frequency: every transition (about 39/min; about 60/min in the first 30 s of the newest upload)
techniques.timing: 85%+ within +-0.1 s of a word onset
techniques.blender: cut list from voice word timings

techniques.name: Motion-continuous cut
techniques.blender: start each push before the shot's first frame

techniques.name: Grade-switch flashback
techniques.size: sepia, or B&W with scan lines
techniques.timing: 4-6 s, hard switch on the cut
techniques.blender: compositor saturation 0 plus a tint

techniques.name: Danger monochrome
techniques.blender: compositor red tint, saturation 0

techniques.name: Whiteout glow transition
techniques.blender: animate bloom mix and exposure +1 over 3 frames
techniques.ffmpeg: eq=brightness ramp plus gblur=sigma=6 on the last 3 frames

techniques.name: Opening pre-roll snap
techniques.trigger: frame 0 grab and the loop seam
techniques.blender: 3 rolled frames (constant interpolation) before shot 1
techniques.ffmpeg: prepend 3 frames of the first shot with rotate=0.45

techniques.name: Soft background on day closes
techniques.blender: depth of field f/2.8 at 2-3 m

techniques.name: Stepped 2D stickers
techniques.size: Z z z or music notes drifting up 40-60 px/s
techniques.blender: Grease Pencil on threes

techniques.name: Caption pop
techniques.blender: n/a

techniques.name: Onomatopoeia caption
techniques.blender: n/a
techniques.ffmpeg: caption event at the effect onset

techniques.name: Sound hits on actions, not cuts
techniques.blender: n/a
techniques.ffmpeg: place effects on the action frame

techniques.name: Same-setup jump cut (expression swap)
techniques.blender: duplicate the shot and swap the face texture

techniques.name: Temperature smash cut
techniques.blender: grade presets per scene

techniques.name: Continuous voice over cuts
techniques.blender: n/a
techniques.ffmpeg: continuous audio tracks; cut picture only

techniques.name: Sound-ring VFX
techniques.frequency: rare (a bell or a loud call)
techniques.size: 2D white concentric rings expanding from the source
techniques.timing: redrawn every 3 frames for about 3 s
techniques.trigger: a bell, horn or shout that matters
techniques.blender: emissive circles scaled up over 9 frames, stepped
techniques.ffmpeg: overlay a 10 fps PNG ring sequence

techniques.name: Stepped jump-cut burst
techniques.size: 3-4 cuts on one set-up, each a little tighter
techniques.trigger: the last beat before the reveal
techniques.blender: one shot cut 3 times with +10% snap pushes

styleTest: About 12 s, 10 shots from the first 3 script lines: night wide with pre-roll snap; ember medium; rule insert; lateral truck; snap push on shocked close; eye ECU; crowd pull-out; top-down; tilt-up reveal hold; close reaction ending mid-word. Compare side by side with a reference reel and Crown Stag Part 2; pass if measure_gneef.py reads brightness 60-100, saturation 0.60-0.72, near-black 30-45%, average shot 0.9-1.3 s, 7 of 10 shots pushing in (STYLE.md section 18)
